== Published English Original Virtual Set 4 wording ==
The original target is an opponent artillery weapon. The later slip names a target artillery weapon without that owner qualification. Both use a piloted AT-AT on Hoth and a related site, and retain the once-per-turn alternate search and immunity to Sense.
